correctness.rationale: The scalar Jury criterion gives the exact common stability domain. Independent Yule-Walker reconstruction gives the closed covariance formula. Strict concavity of the curvature denominator confines the worst variance to the spectral endpoints. Each endpoint as a function of signed momentum decreases then increases, with unique minimum at sqrt(h)-1, and the two endpoint values cross only at (a+b)/2-1, proving the unique median classifier. The low-curvature factor two follows by exact substitution. Reproducible Lyapunov and scalar minimization checks corroborate; finite checks are not the proof.
